# UX & Requirements Quality Checklist: การแสดงจำนวนสินค้าคงเหลือ/ชั่งขาย และปรับปรุงตะกร้าสินค้า POS

**Purpose**: ตรวจสอบคุณภาพ ความครบถ้วน และความชัดเจนของข้อกำหนดด้าน UI/UX และการเข้าถึงตามมาตรฐาน Elderly-Friendly
**Created**: 2026-10-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness & Coverage

- [ ] CHK001 Are visual presentation requirements defined for all product card stock states (in stock, low stock, out of stock, by weight)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK002 Are fallback icon requirements specified when a cart item lacks an image or image fails to load? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Are scroll target behaviors defined for both newly added products and quantity increments of existing products? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 Are error and offline fallback states defined when the branch inventory API is unreachable? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Clarity & Measurability

- [ ] CHK005 Is the "ชั่งขาย" status badge specified with clear visual contrast and color criteria? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK006 Are cart thumbnail dimensions explicitly bounded with minimum and maximum size constraints? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the visual highlight duration and animation style quantified with specific timing thresholds? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK008 Are stock count display formats quantified with their respective unit of measure (UOM)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]

## UI Consistency & Elderly-Friendly Design

- [ ] CHK009 Do all interactive buttons in the cart row maintain minimum 48x48px touch targets alongside the new thumbnail? [Consistency, Constitution §6.5, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK010 Is text truncation (line-clamp) specified for long product names to avoid displacing row action buttons? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Are color contrast ratios for stock status badges specified to meet WCAG 2.1 AA (at least 4.5:1)? [Accessibility, Constitution §6.5, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK012 Are font sizes for stock numbers and cart product titles specified to remain at least 16px for readability? [Accessibility, Constitution §6.5]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
